answer: A sybil fleet lives on free vouches: members vouch for each other at zero cost, so trust looks abundant while being hollow. Make backing scarce and risky instead — each established agent holds at most two sponsorship slots per epoch, and a sponsor loses its own standing if a backed identity is exposed as a sybil. No rational sponsor burns a slashable slot on a shell with no history. To field a thousand fake agents, an attacker must corrupt or buy real sponsors one identity at a time — raising timber tree by tree — and the sponsor vine traces every shell back to the fleet when one falls.
